dish.note: Sticky cinnamon buns glazed in warm honey butter, enough to sleep through winter on.
dish.how: Unroll the pastry, brush with half the melted butter and scatter with the brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up from the long side, cut into eight and sit the buns in a buttered tin. Bake at 200°C for 18 minutes until golden. Warm the honey with the rest of the butter and spoon it over the hot buns.
dish.make_ahead: Roll and cut the buns up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; bake and glaze to serve

steps.text: Brush the pastry with half the butter and scatter with the sugar and cinnamon.
Roll up from the long side, cut into eight and sit the buns in a buttered tin.
Warm the honey with the rest of the butter and spoon over the hot buns.
